notes.title: Refreshed UI
notes.content:
Thanks for your awesome support on this game!

I've updated some of the game's interface elements to improve its visual appeal, and now you can zoom out by clicking the right mouse button

Have fun!

notes.title: Fixed a small bug
notes.content:
I've fixed a little issue with the lighting in the environment.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Some UI adjustements
notes.content:
Hi there, escape room lovers!

In this update I've just fixed some UI stuff, it should look a bit better now ;)

Enjoy!

notes.title: Fixed the puzzle tiles saving bug
notes.content:
Thanks for your awesome support for Mystery Box! In this update, I've fixed the bug on saving the tiles you find to discover the artifacts.

Have fun!

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.content:
Hi there, and Happy New Year!

Some bugs have been squashed here and there

notes.title: Show us your appreciation!
notes.content: Thanks for playing this escape room/puzzle game, if you enjoy it, [b]please consider nominating it above, it's a simple click, but it means the world to me[/b] ❤️‍🔥

notes.title: Now you can reset the game
notes.content:
Thanks for your awesome support with [b]Mystery Box[/b]! In this update, I've added an option to reset the game in the Setting menu, which will delete all your progress and let you play the adventure from the beginning

[b]NOTE[/b]: Achievements won't be deleted
